about_the_game:
Explore the east side of Austria from Wien (Vienna) to Payerbach with this Train Simulator route from RSSLO.

Featuring 28 stations this route offers lots to see as you drive along the line. Start at bustling capital Wien Hbf and pass through urban neighbourhoods glimpsing the architecture of the city before heading out into the scenic Austrian countryside. Pass forests, rivers and historic quaint villages. Notable stops along the route include Mödling at the entrance to the Brühl Valley, Wiener Neustadt which is famous for one of the world’s oldest military academies, and the popular railfan town of Gloggnitz set in breathtaking mountain scenery. At the other end of the line arrive at the idyllic Alpine village and Payerbach-Reichenau station.

On this route you will be taking control of the ÖBB 1116 ‘Taurus’. Based on the Eurosprinter this electric is used for passenger and freight duties along the line. A suitable selection of rolling stock is included for this task, including three types of ÖBB coaches and three types of freight wagons. Five Career scenarios included with the route will test your driving skills as you try to keep to time on ÖBB Regional Express (REX) services.

Discover the natural beauty and historic towns of Austria along the rails of Payerbach - Wien Hbf in Train Simulator.

Included Scenarios

A selection of engaging Career scenarios are included:

  • REX 3 - 2253

  • REX 3 - 2902

  • REX 9 - 1972

  • REX 9 - 1955

  • REX 1 - 2342

More scenarios are available on the Steam Workshop online and in-game. Train Simulator’s Steam Workshop scenarios are free and easy to download, adding many more hours of exciting gameplay. With scenarios being added daily, why don’t you check it out now!

Key Features

  • 85-km recreation of Payerbach - Wien Hbf route

  • 28 detailed stations

  • Authentic landscapes and scenery

  • Realistic signalling and track signage

  • ÖBB 1116 electric locomotive

  • Passenger rolling stock includes ÖBB Bmpz-I, Bmz 21, and BMpz DL coaches

  • Freight rolling stock includes Snps, Habbins and Eanos wagons

  • 5 Career scenarios

  • Quick Drive compatible

  • Download size: 1.8 GB

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum for 32-bit:
  • OS *: 32-bit Windows 7 Service Pack 1, 8.1 or 10 Required (Other OS versions and types are not supported)
  • Processor: Intel Core-i3 4330 3.50 GHz Dual Core or AMD A8 6600K 3.90 GHz Quad Core or Better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R9 Graphics with 1 GB Dedicated VRAM or Better
  • DirectX®: 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Connection (May incur additional costs for use)
  • Storage: 40 GB or more available space (Additional Add-Ons will require more)
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires mouse and keyboard or Xbox Controller
Laptop, Notebook, Mobile or Low Power versions of the above specifications (including Intel or Integrated Graphics) may work but are not supported. Updates to Chipset, Graphics and Audio Device Drivers may be required. For information relating to recommended specifications for Train Simulator 64-bit, please refer to the Train Simulator Classic User Guide.
